Module 07: Publication I — Rendering Your Edition: Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, students will be able to:

  • Explain why a TEI file is not yet a publication, and how one encoded file can produce several views (diplomatic, reading, print).
  • Decide and record a display decision for every element your file uses (<lb/>, <choice>, <abbr>/<expan>, <unclear>, <gap/>), and hand-write the HTML and CSS that carry them out.
  • Render the same TEI file automatically with an XSLT stylesheet and with CETEIcean in the browser, and add a print stylesheet.
  • Audit an AI-generated stylesheet element by element against your hand-made page, catching dropped, merged, or silently normalized text.
